components.name: Weights
components.explanation: Exact remote file size of the Q6_K variant.

components.name: KV cache
components.explanation: 8 layers x 4 KV heads x 256 head_dim x 4096 tokens x batch 1 x 2 bytes x 1 sessions x 2. Plus the recurrent state of the linear-attention layers.

components.name: Runtime overhead
components.explanation: Base 0.50 GiB + 10% of weights (0.70 GiB). CPU allowance, not GPU calibration. CPU repacking is runtime-dependent and is not separately sized; this heuristic is not an upper bound.

runtime_overhead_components.name: CPU compute allowance
runtime_overhead_components.explanation: 0.25 GiB heuristic; actual compute buffers depend on token batching.

runtime_overhead_components.name: Other CPU runtime allowance
runtime_overhead_components.explanation: Remaining general runtime heuristic; not a measured allocation.

runtime_overhead_components.name: CPU repacking
runtime_overhead_components.explanation: Depends on tensor types, CPU kernels and runtime build. Not separately added to the heuristic total.

kv_cache.formula: kv_bytes = 2 * attention_layers * num_kv_heads * head_dim * context * batch * concurrent_users * bytes_per_kv_element + recurrent_layers * state_bytes_per_layer * batch * concurrent_users
notes: Hybrid attention: 8 of 33 layers keep a KV cache (full attention every 4 layers); the other 25 keep a constant recurrent state of 52 MiB for 1 sequence(s), in float32 whatever the KV precision. Checked against one llama.cpp measurement (Qwen3.8-27B, D120).
Grouped-Query Attention: 4 KV heads for 16 attention heads.

reasons: CPU consumption is checked separately from the desired RAM reserve and margin.

assumptions: KV cache dtype assumed to be float16.
GGUF CPU headroom: 512 MiB of RAM; the GPU's 1 GiB minimum does not apply.
No automatic percentage margin is added to GGUF headroom.
